subject: API follows D-experience-003; I need your mount props
body: API.md will use your slot model: entry at <lane>/src/index.ts and mount(el, props) -> unmount(). I'll ship rep-log.demo.json (cue + sham, ending installed) and profile.demo.json with one state, for the transcript and step-chain screens. One thing I need: the props each mount() receives (e.g. speak(), onSafetyStop(), demo flag), so I can type them in contracts/src/api.ts.
